Overview of a omics_array object

Source: R/omics_array.R
head-omics_array-method.Rd

Overview of a omics_array object.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'omics_array'
head(x, ...)

Arguments

x

an object of class `omics_array`.

...

additional parameters

Methods

list("signature(x = \"ANY\")")

Gives an overview.

list("signature(x = \"omics_array\")")

Gives an overview.

Author

Bertrand Frederic, Myriam Maumy-Bertrand.

Examples


 if(require(CascadeData)){
  data(micro_US)
  micro_US<-as.omics_array(micro_US,time=c(60,90,210,390),subject=6)
  head(micro_US)
  }
